unit.id: Island Evolution#1
Evolution usually takes place over thousands of years. In this simulation, many generations pass within a few minutes, so you can observe how a population changes over time.#1

segment.source: Evolution usually takes place over thousands of years. In this simulation, many generations pass within a few minutes, so you can observe how a population changes over time.
segment.target: Évolusi biasané dumadi nganti éwonan taun. Ing simulasi iki, akèh generasi liwat sajroné sawetara menit, mula kowé bisa mirsani owah-owahan populasi saka wektu ke wektu.

unit.id: The scenario#1
A small population of creatures lives on an isolated island. Their only source of food is a few scattered berry bushes. Once a bush has been eaten, it takes some time for new berries to grow.#1

segment.source: A small population of creatures lives on an isolated island. Their only source of food is a few scattered berry bushes. Once a bush has been eaten, it takes some time for new berries to grow.
segment.target: Populasi cilik makhluk urip ing pulo sing kapisah. Sumber pangan siji-sijiné yaiku sawetara grumbul woh beri sing sumebar. Sawisé woh ing grumbul dipangan, butuh wektu kanggo woh anyar thukul.
